issues.explanation: This combines the title 王 with the personal name 刘胜.
issues.suggested_fix: Separate the title from the name, e.g. 靖王 and 刘胜.

issues.explanation: The segment is labeled as a name even though it contains both a royal title and a personal name.
issues.suggested_fix: Label 刘胜 as a name and treat 王 as part of the title.

issues.explanation: 靖王 is the posthumous title; 靖 should not be isolated from 王.
issues.suggested_fix: Group 靖 with 王 as the title 靖王.

issues.explanation: In this context 为 is the copula “be,” not “belong to.”
issues.suggested_fix: Gloss it as “be.”

issues.explanation: Here 之后 means “descendant/posterity,” not the temporal word “after.”
issues.suggested_fix: Gloss it as “descendant of” or “posterity of.”

issues.explanation: This is a compositional subject-predicate phrase, not one dictionary word.
issues.suggested_fix: Separate 父 “father” and 亡 “die.”

issues.explanation: This is a compositional verb-object phrase.
issues.suggested_fix: Separate 孝 “be filial” and 母 “mother.”

issues.explanation: This is a compositional subject-predicate phrase.
issues.suggested_fix: Separate 家 “family” and 贫 “poor.”

issues.explanation: This is the verb-object phrase “weave mats,” not a single lexical word.
issues.suggested_fix: Separate 织 “weave” and 席 “mat.”

issues.explanation: A numeral and measurement unit should be separate learner segments.
issues.suggested_fix: Separate 七 and 尺.

issues.explanation: A numeral and measurement unit should be separate learner segments.
issues.suggested_fix: Separate 五 and 寸.

issues.explanation: In this sentence the characters mean “ears droop,” not the noun 耳垂 “earlobe.”
issues.suggested_fix: Separate 耳 “ears” and 垂 “hang down.”

issues.explanation: The gloss describes a whole clause and incorrectly invokes “earlobes”; locally the phrase describes the ears drooping to the shoulders.
issues.suggested_fix: Use separate local glosses such as 耳 “ears” and 垂 “droop.”

issues.explanation: 宽和 is a lexicalized adjective meaning gentle, mild, or even-tempered.
issues.suggested_fix: Group 宽和 and gloss it as “gentle; mild.”

issues.explanation: This is a compositional numeral-plus-age-unit phrase, not one dictionary word.
issues.suggested_fix: Separate 二十八 and 岁.

issues.explanation: This is an ordinary verb-object phrase.
issues.suggested_fix: Separate 看 “look at” and 榜 “posted list.”

issues.explanation: Here 主动 functions adverbially, meaning “on his own initiative” or “proactively,” not the verb “take the initiative.”
issues.suggested_fix: Gloss it as “proactively; on his own initiative.”

issues.explanation: 共 is an adverb modifying 举大事; 共举 is not the natural lexical segmentation here.
issues.suggested_fix: Separate 共 “together” and 举 “undertake.”

issues.explanation: This is an ordinary verb-object phrase.
issues.suggested_fix: Separate 推 “push” and 车 “cart.”

issues.explanation: The numeral and noun/classifier should be separate learner segments; this applies to both occurrences.
issues.suggested_fix: Separate 三 and 人.

issues.explanation: This is a numeral-plus-classifier phrase, not one dictionary word.
issues.suggested_fix: Separate 五十 and 匹.

issues.explanation: This is a numeral-plus-unit phrase, not one dictionary word.
issues.suggested_fix: Separate 五百 and 两.

issues.explanation: This is a numeral-plus-unit phrase, not one dictionary word.
issues.suggested_fix: Separate 一千 and 斤.

issues.explanation: This is a compositional quantity expression; 多 is the approximation suffix/modifier.
issues.suggested_fix: Separate 五百 and 多.

issues.explanation: “Recognize as” is the meaning of the construction 认……为……, not of 认 alone.
issues.suggested_fix: Gloss 认 as “recognize; acknowledge,” leaving the construction meaning to the grammar overlay.

issues.explanation: 同心 is a lexical adverbial expression meaning “with one heart,” not a standalone grammatical pattern; this overlay redundantly summarizes the clause.
issues.suggested_fix: Remove this grammar overlay and retain the lexical explanation for 同心.
